Summer Paragliding Fethiye 2026

June, July & August: the peak season for Fethiye tandem flights. Strongest thermals, longest flights, hottest weather.

Why Summer Is Peak Season

Summer in Fethiye means consistent sunshine, powerful thermals, and flights lasting 35-50 minutes — the longest of the year. The intense Mediterranean heat creates strong anabatic thermals along Babadağ Mountain's south face, lifting paragliders well above the 1,960m launch altitude.

June

35-40°C at sea level, 20-25°C at launch. Strong thermals. 30-45 min flights. Sunset at 20:30 — great for evening flights. Crowds building but manageable.

July

38-42°C at sea level. Peak thermals. 35-50 min flights possible. Highest crowds — book 3+ days ahead. Best acrobatic conditions.

August

37-40°C at sea level. Very similar to July. Peak tourism season. Consistent, reliable flying. Water temperature perfect for post-flight swimming.

Summer Flying Tips

  • ☀️ Book morning flights (08:00): Smoother air, cooler at altitude, less waiting time
  • 💧 Hydrate well: Drink 1L+ water before your flight. Altitude + heat = dehydration risk
  • 🧴 Sunscreen: UV at 2,000m is intense. Apply before the flight — you can't reapply in the air
  • 👕 Light clothing: It's warm even at altitude in summer. T-shirt + light jacket is fine. See what to wear guide
  • 📅 Book in advance: Peak season fills up fast. Reserve at least 2-3 days before

Summer Prices

Prices are the same year-round: $150 (Professional Tandem) or $190 (4K Media Bundle). No peak season surcharge. See complete price details. VIP flights are especially popular in summer.
